explore-directors.title: Add directors
explore-directors.prompt: Add directors until the forward gain reaches at least 8.5 dBd.
explore-directors.success: Each extra director on a longer boom adds gain and narrows the beam.

explore-spacing.title: Best front-to-back
explore-spacing.prompt: Choose the element spacing that gives the best front-to-back ratio.
explore-spacing.success: About 0.2 λ gives the best front-to-back. Wider spacing gives a little more gain but less front-to-back.
